sloka: यस्यार्थास्तस्य मित्राणि यस्यार्थास्तस्य बान्धवाः।यस्यार्थाः स पुमान् लोके यस्यार्थाः स च पण्डितः ।। ६.८३.३५ ।।
transliteration: yasyārthāstasya mitrāṇi yasyārthāstasya bāndhavāḥ।yasyārthāḥ sa pumān loke yasyārthāḥ sa ca paṇḍitaḥ ।। 6.83.35 ।।

translations.english: "Friends gather round him in whom riches abide. Relations stand by him who has wealth. He is considered manly in whom wealth abides, and he is learned who has wealth."
